verdict.rationale: Dots is a cloud-hosted agent product, so a buyer could reasonably ask whether it offers versioned APIs with a deprecation policy, and the axis applies. The evidence shows no such surface: OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the runtime probe found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or MCP-server surface. No versioning or deprecation policy is documented anywhere.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
